ha.name: Hausa
ha.greeting: Sannu. Ni mataimakin AI ne. Me ya kawo ka yau?
ha.correction: A'a, ya fara kwana biyu da suka wuce.
ha.acknowledge: Na gode. Likita zai duba bayanin.
ha.adviceReply: Ba zan iya zabar magani ba. Likita zai taimaka maka.

ig.name: Igbo
ig.greeting: Ndewo. Abụ m onye enyemaka AI. Gịnị mere i ji bịa taa?
ig.correction: Mba, ọ malitere ụbọchị abụọ gara aga.
ig.adviceReply: Enweghị m ike ịhọrọ ọgwụ. Dọkịta ga-enyere gị aka.

yo.name: Yoruba
yo.greeting: Ẹ káàbọ̀. Mo jẹ́ olùrànlọ́wọ́ AI. Kí ló mú yín wá lónìí?
yo.correction: Rárá, ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ méjì sẹ́yìn.
yo.medicineQuestion: Ṣé ẹ ti lo oògùn kankan?
yo.acknowledge: Ẹ ṣé. Dókítà yóò ṣàyẹ̀wò àlàyé náà.
yo.advice: Oògùn wo ni kí n lò?
yo.adviceReply: Mi ò lè yan oògùn. Dókítà yóò ràn yín lọ́wọ́.

english.greeting: Hello. I am an AI assistant. What brings you here today?
english.correction: No, it started two days ago.
english.medicines: I have not taken any medicine.
english.acknowledge: Thank you. A clinician will review the information.
english.adviceReply: I cannot choose a medicine. A clinician can help you.
